items.rationale: A1/A2/C2: Cornulețe clears normal through DEX/MDA pastry evidence, older/current RRI and current AGERPRES regional-recipe coverage. A3/A4/A7: the rolled filled pastry, jam/walnut/rahat and home/holiday claims are specific and sourced. A5/A6: no boundary trigger or approved Contexto duplicate. C1: concrete food. C3: exactly five recognizable direct neighbors, zero lint flags and 2,289 reachable. C4: repaired Gem and Nucă rank2, Prăjitură4, Cozonac6, Făină9, Desert14. C5: bare singular has horn/botanical/figurative senses, but standalone plural in gastronomie and all new cu gem forms select pastry. C6: .55 clears normal. Refute-first, unrelated Sarmale remains rank8/Fierbinte, while butter/oil are Rece596 and rahat is unknown. That noise is material, but four distinct defining/category paths rank at or above it and make the target navigable. Promote at normal without claiming uniform feedback or a human playtest.

A1/A2/C2: Gogoși is universal cross-generational Romanian food vocabulary, supported by DEX/DLRLC, RRI and current national PRO TV family-recipe coverage. A3/A4/A7: standard leavened dough fried in oil, dusted with sugar and optionally served or filled with gem is honest; seven dessert/fried-dough/street-food neighbors are factual. A5/A6: no trigger or duplicate. C1: concrete dessert. C3: seven direct neighbors, zero flags, 2,289 reachable. C4: repaired Gem, Ulei and Desert rank2; Papanași3, Prăjitură12, Făină20, Drojdie27, Lapte44. C5: gogoși can mean lies and the noun has cocoon/swelling senses, but those normally require phrase/context; gastronomie and qualified gogoașa prăjită select food. C6: .72 clears usor. Refute-first, butter/nut remain frozen and pan is Rece407; gem is a variant, not universal. The two repaired routes plus dessert and dough routes independently support easy play. Promote.

A1/A2/C2: Telemea clears easy through DEX, EU evidence of national standardized production (about 24,000 tonnes in 2014), protected-product specifications and current AGERPRES/Romfilatelia coverage. A3/A4/A7: brined cheese and its salt, dairy, polenta, pastry and Romanian-cheese relations are specific. A5/A6: no trigger or duplicate. C1/C5: concrete cheese with one dominant sense. C3: ten recognizable direct neighbors, zero flags, 2,289 reachable. C4: repaired Sare and Brânză rank2, Mămăligă4, Plăcinte6, Lapte14. All four reviewed case/sort-plural forms win. C6: .6784 clears usor. Refute-first, defining saramură remains unknown and Drojdie is spuriously warm13; butter/oil are cold. Salt supplies the missing defining process cue, while cheese/polenta/pastry/milk give independent ordinary routes. The yeast anomaly does not dominate the top feedback. Promote with the brine-vocabulary gap disclosed.

A1/A2/C2: Cartofi prăjiți is universal contemporary and cross-generational food vocabulary; older/current PRO TV coverage uses the unqualified dish and documents ordinary oil frying. A3/A4/A7: cut potatoes fried in oil and served as snack/garnish is honest, with air-fryer/no-oil variants explicitly qualified; all six direct ingredient/preparation/serving neighbors are specific. A5/A6: no trigger or duplicate. C1/C5: concrete unambiguous compound. C3: six recognizable direct neighbors, zero flags, 2,289 reachable. C4: repaired Ulei and Cartof rank2, Șnițel3, Mici4, Mâncare stradală5, Air fryer7; Sare29 remains warm. Three new singular/case forms win. C6: .6932 clears usor. Refute-first, Drojdie is spuriously warm18, Tigaie only Călduț126 and butter very cold. The top seven results still contain five highly legible concepts, led by both defining inputs. Promote without claiming every variant uses oil.

A1/A2/C2: Ardei umpluți is broadly known, with MDA2 explicitly defining the compound and older/current RRI plus current PRO TV documenting family recipes. A3/A4/A7: pepper shell and meat/rice or vegetarian fillings are honest; rice, vegetable, tomato, sarmale and serving relations are specific. A5/A6: no trigger or duplicate. C1/C5: concrete compound with one dominant dish sense. C3: eight recognizable direct neighbors, zero flags, 2,289 reachable. C4: repaired Ardei and Orez rank2, Legume3, Sarmale4, Roșie5, Mămăligă7 and Carne21. Ardei keeps its own public identity and cannot win. C6: .5882 clears normal. Refute-first, Drojdie is misleadingly Fierbinte11 while oil/butter are cold; meat is not universal because fasting versions exist. Six more obvious defining/filling/serving routes precede yeast, so the anomaly does not make the normal target opaque. Promote with the noise and variant qualification recorded.
